plan: Each threadgroup computes BN output columns. All TG threads split the K dimension: each thread takes one packed uint32 (8 nibbles) per step, loads its 8 activations once and reuses them for all BN weight rows, and gets more memory-level parallelism from several simdgroups per tile. Nibbles are extracted MLX-style by masking against activations pre-scaled by powers of 1/16, with bias*sum(act) folded in. Partial sums are reduced with simd_sum and then across simdgroups in threadgroup memory; the residual add x+res is done in fp32 at the final write.
